name: Suffix Subgroup
description: You are given a group of n strings: s 1 , s 2 , ..., s n . You should find a subgroup s i 1 , s i 2 , ..., s i k (1 ≤ i 1 < i 2 < ... < i k ≤ n ) of the group. The following two conditions must hold: there exists a string t such, that each string from found subgroup is its suffix; the number of strings in the found subgroup is as large as possible. Your task is to print the number of strings in the found subgroup.
input_specification: The first line contains an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10 5 ) — the number of strings in the group. Each of the next n lines contains a string. The i -th line contains non-empty string s i . Each string consists only from lowercase Latin letters. The sum of all strings s i doesn't exceed 10 5 .
output_specification: Output a single integer — the number of strings in the found subgroup.

topic_editorial.key_invariant: The prefix function $\pi[i]$ defines the length of the longest proper prefix of $S[0..i]$ that is also a suffix of $S[0..i]$. When a mismatch occurs at index $j$, we do not backtrack in text; we jump to $\pi[j-1]$, preserving previously matched characters.
